title: Fiery Serpent Over Broken Sea
description: A surreal serpentine creature with a large cracked red spherical head covered in multiple green eyes and crowned with black flames emerges from dark turbulent water. It holds a small flaming skull in one hand and a wooden oar in the other, surrounded by smoke, embers, and shattered glass-like fragments against a pink and purple sky.
